build_s2t_berard_model: build a speech-to-text translation model using the BerardModel encoder-decoder architecture
build_berard_encoder: build a BerardEncoder with linear layers, conv2d layers, and bidirectional LSTM for speech features
build_lstm_decoder: build an LSTMDecoder with Bahdanau MLP attention for autoregressive text generation
build_mlp_attention: build an MLPAttention module that computes Bahdanau attention scores between encoder and decoder states
review_berard_architecture: review the s2t_berard model architecture variants including 256_3_3, 512_3_2, and 512_5_3
